en: I'm looking for a Golduck. Would you swap one for my Lickitung?
A Golduck! Wonderful. Marc will look after you, I promise. Look after him too.
That's not a Golduck. I'm hoping for a Golduck.
That's fine. If you ever have a Golduck to spare, come back.
Golduck swims better than I ever expected. I hope Marc is licking his way to fame.
